claims.text: ↑risk of breast CA and low AE risk: offer risk-reducing meds (tamoxifen, raloxifene or aromatase inhibitors)
claims.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians offer to prescribe risk-reducing medications, such as tamoxifen, raloxifene, or aromatase inhibitors, to women who are at increased risk for breast cancer and at low risk for adverse medication effects.
claims.locator: USPSTF Recommendation: Breast Cancer: Medication Use to Reduce Risk (September 3, 2019)
